title: Installation and setup
description: Wizard for the agent, V2bX, tunnel, and BBR. No script or shell command is executed.
statusNote: Statuses: pending, validating, installing, configuring, testing, completed, failed, rolled back.

wizard.demoPreflight: This list is a demo preflight.

operational.title: Operational installation and setup
operational.description: Choose a registered bundle, preview the version, and follow the Agent result.
operational.v2bxBody: Use the host identifier, the reviewed binary, the hash, and the configuration file in the local build tool. The output includes the host bundle and the registration specification for the backend.
operational.disabled: Operational provisioning is disabled in the server settings.
operational.empty: No bundle has been registered yet.
operational.upload: Upload bundle files for the Agent (including manifest.json)
operational.confirmBody: Register the installation of {component} version {version} on {server}?
operational.artifactsReady: Approved files are ready for the Agent to download
operational.rollbackBody: The agent compares the current files before restoring them.
operational.coordinated: This stage is managed from the tunnel page.
operational.reviewBody: After reviewing the Worker process and the host files, record the manual result.

detail.attached: Existing V2bX configuration was recognized and its link to the panel was confirmed.
detail.verified: Installation and path test were confirmed.
detail.leased: The agent has taken the job
detail.applied: The agent confirmed that the configuration was applied
detail.listener_conflict: A different managed service owns this port. Choose independent tunnel ports.
detail.reverted: After an error, the agent returned to the previous state
detail.external_change: The current file does not match the previous installation
detail.interrupted: The Worker stopped in the middle of the job
detail.agent_missing: The agent report deadline has passed
detail.queue_expired: The job delivery deadline has passed
detail.tcp_target_unreachable: The destination service did not accept TCP on the configured target port. Changes were rolled back.
detail.tcp_forward_unreachable: The destination accepted TCP, but the forwarded port did not. Changes were rolled back.

catalog.title: Register bundle metadata
catalog.body: Select the enrollment.json file or paste its contents. After the hosts and hashes are reviewed, you can register the catalog. The installation request is registered in a separate step.
catalog.invalidJson: The text must be valid JSON.
catalog.saved: Bundle metadata was registered in the catalog
catalog.tooLarge: The metadata file is too large.
catalog.summary: {added} bundles and {updated} mappings will be registered in the catalog

agent.title: Deploy with Agent
agent.body: Install the NodeGuard Agent from the host details first. An active Agent downloads the bundle from the panel.
agent.disabled: Provisioning is not enabled in the control plane.
agent.rebuild: Rebuild the tunnel with the node's current port
agent.secondNodeHint: Optional. One V2bX service on this server runs both nodes, each with its own settings.
agent.choosePath: Select a compatible path to install
agent.noPath: No compatible path is registered for installation
agent.forwardLead: iptables on the source forwards TCP port
agent.rebuildBody: The node port is read again. After the new bundle is ready, the previous installation is removed and the new bundle is installed.
agent.installBody: The approved bundle is prepared on the destination host, and the Worker records and checks the operation.
agent.installTwoBody: Both nodes are installed in one V2bX service on the foreign host, each with its own settings.
agent.queued: The bundle is ready and the installation job was queued.
